First public release. `lines()` splits Unix or Windows text into lines and keeps empty lines, so line numbers stay aligned with the source.

## Try it with your data

With Node.js 24.11+ and `example-lines` installed:

```js
import { lines } from "example-lines";

lines("alpha\r\n\r\nbeta"); // ["alpha", "", "beta"]
```

## Upgrade from 0.0.x

No caller changes are needed. The API is the same as the last 0.0.x prototype.
